Short title 1. This Act may be called the Lasbela University of Agriculture, Water and Marine Sciences Act, 2010 and it shall come into force at once.
Definitions 2. In this Act, University means the Lasbela University established under the Ordinance of
2002) and reconstituted by this Act for the Province of Balochistan.
Constitution 3. The University shall consist of the Chancellor, the Vice Chancellor and the members of the Syndicate.
Powers 4. The University shall have the power to provide for instruction in agriculture, water and marine sciences.
Jurisdiction 5. The University shall exercise its powers throughout the district of Lasbela and such other area as is notified.
Officers 6. The officers of the University shall include the Chancellor, the Vice Chancellor, the Registrar and the Treasurer.
Chancellor 7. The Governor shall be the Chancellor of the University and shall preside whenever he is present.
Vice Chancellor 8. The Vice Chancellor shall be the chief executive of the University and shall ensure the due observance of this Act.
Registrar 9. The Registrar shall be the custodian of the records and the common seal of the University.
Treasurer 10. The Treasurer shall prepare the budget and shall keep the accounts of the University in the prescribed form.
Controller 11. The Controller of Examinations shall be responsible for the conduct of the examinations of the University.
Authorities 12. The Authorities of the University shall be the Senate, the Syndicate and the Academic Council.
Senate 13. The Senate shall review the acts of the Syndicate and shall consider the annual report of the University.
Academic Council 14. The Academic Council shall be the academic body and shall lay down proper standards of instruction.
Committees 15. The Syndicate may appoint committees of its members to inquire into any matter referred to them.
Statutes 16. The Statutes may provide for the constitution of the Faculties only so far as a later schedule states.
Regulations 17. The Academic Council may make regulations consistent with this Act and the Statutes of the University.
Procedure 18. The Syndicate may regulate the procedure at its meetings and the conduct of its business.
Syndicate 19. (1) The Syndicate shall consist of the Vice Chancellor and the members appointed under this Act.
(2) Members of the Syndicate shall hold office for three years from the date of their appointment.
3. The quorum for a meeting of the Syndicate shall be one-half of the total number of members.
Power and duties 20. (i) The Syndicate shall be the executive body of the University and shall manage its property and funds.
(2) The Provident Fund Act, 1925 shall apply to the fund of the University as if it were a Government fund.
(3) Commencement of term of a member shall be the date notified by the Chancellor in the official Gazette.
